claim_updates.reason: Frozen decision rule requires ALL conditions C1-C6 for SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST; C4 (B_UNFIXED_PROTOCOL_ONLY) fails due to test design flaw where Fix2 subsumes Fix3 for the frozen URL pair. However, C1-C3 provide strong positive evidence: URL binding accuracy 1.0 (9/9), HTTP binding accuracy 1.0 (9/9) on valid unseen IDs, literal baseline also 9/9, comment body validation fix works, kernel regression 3/3 pass. Claim ceiling expands from 'synthetic single-slot GET URL construction' to 'committed-code synthetic single-slot GET with real HTTP binding on jsonplaceholder.typicode.com'. Fix3 necessity not demonstrated; Fix3 is redundant with Fix2 for tested pattern and overbroad for host?query patterns. Remains EXPERIMENTAL (not VALIDATED/PRODUCT_CORE) due to frozen gate failure and open Fix3 issues.

First actual tokenization data point: parameterized 68 tokens vs literal 96 tokens (29.17% savings) with tiktoken cl100k_base. However, single measurement, structural advantage (3 vs 9 encodings), not amortized cost per successful real-browser task. Remains HYPOTHESIS pending end-to-end economics.

next_question: Can Fix3 (_is_protocol_only_prefix) be redesigned to reject only truly protocol-only prefixes (no '/' in rest) without blocking valid host?query parameterization, and can a discriminating test demonstrate its independent necessity over Fix2?
reason: The experiment resolves the parent MEASUREMENT_INVALID blocker (V1_HTTP_DESIGN_IMPOSSIBLE_IDS) and demonstrates real HTTP binding correctness 9/9 on valid IDs. However, the frozen decision rule triggers FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING because C4 fails: the B_UNFIXED_PROTOCOL_ONLY test is non-discriminating for the frozen URL pair (Fix2 subsumes Fix3). Additionally, Fix3 is overbroad, blocking valid host?query parameterization (audit V2). The scientific finding is mixed: C1-C3 strong PASS, C4 test design flaw. The claim ceiling expands to include real HTTP binding on jsonplaceholder GET endpoints. Next step should address Fix3 redesign to be non-redundant and non-overbroad, or pivot to orthogonal high-upside question such as PUT/POST method fidelity or end-to-end economics.
